problem: Production language switching on /prijzen failed because the localized wildcard rewrites for nested /en/* and /nl/* pages disappeared from _redirects after the earlier pricing/i18n repair.
root_cause: A later repository change preserved only the locale root rewrites (/en and /nl) but removed the nested wildcard rewrites. The previous prevention test existed, yet the material route mutation landed without preserving the production routing invariant, so /en/prijzen no longer resolved to /en/prijzen.html.
failed_approaches: Treating a prior LIVE_BEWEZEN claim as durable evidence after subsequent unrelated changes.
Verifying locale root routes without re-reading the current nested-route rewrite contract.
Assuming the language-switch failure was still caused by the translation provider before checking current production routing.
prevention: Every public i18n production readback must test at least one nested localized route such as /en/prijzen, not only /en.
The /en/* -> /en/:splat.html and /nl/* -> /nl/:splat.html rewrites are invariant routing rules and may not be removed by later changes.
A new failure after an earlier LIVE_BEWEZEN release invalidates reliance on the old claim; current main and current production must be re-read.
Material routing fixes require same-lineage Brain learning, activity ledger, human documentation and production readback.

evidence.observed_production: /prijzen exposed 'Switching language failed. Try again.' and /en/prijzen was unavailable on 2026-09-24.
